text:
maya: Quick pre-cut CI health check — can we get a green sweep on main by EOD? I saw a recurring flake in integration tests last night. :eyes:
ci-bot: Build 5498 failed on job integration-suite (see https://ci.redwood/5498). Failing test: tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py::test_evict_under_load
alex: thanks. @nina @sam any idea if this is the flaky we've been chasing? last fix seemed to reduce frequency but not gone.
nina: saw 3 fails in last 24h. stack shows timeout at ~90s. test has hard-coded 60s in CI. suspect timing regression from allocator change.
sam: I can run a focused rerun. command: `make ci-rerun JOB=integration-suite --filter=kv_cache`
jo: if it's timing, temporary bumping the test timeout to 120s on the cut branch could prevent cut-blocker. propose small PR: `tests: bump timeout for kv_cache flake (temp)`
maya: prefer temporary test timeout + create follow-up issue to root-cause. can we also add the failing tests to flaky-rotations?
alex: agreed. @infra-bot can you queue a canary run on dedicated infra (no preemption) to check if it's infra noise?
infra-bot: Scheduled canary run 5501 on dedicated-g4x. Link: https://ci.redwood/5501 :white_check_mark:
nina: also adding a short log snippet from failing run:
```
E   TimeoutError: test exceeded 60s waiting for eviction
  tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py:87
```
looks like eviction latency spike.
sam: rerun started for failed tests: `cictl rerun --build=5498 --only failed`
ci-bot: Rerun 5498.1 queued. test group: integration-suite (focus: kv_cache).
jo: I'll open PR to bump timeout and add a TODO/issue link. pinging for 2 reviewers: @maya @alex
maya: happy to review. please include changelog note: 'ci: temporary timeout bump to mitigate pre-cut flake'
alex: once PR lands, can we trigger a full green-sweep? also remind teams to freeze non-critical merges after cutoff at 1900 UTC.
nina: PR #3287 created: `test(kv): temp timeout bump` — draft CI flag set. Link: https://git.redwood/3287
sam: rerun results: Rerun 5498.1 passed integration-suite on canary infra. Looks stable for now. :thumbsup:
maya: awesome. schedule: cutoff 1900 UTC. After PR merge, I'll start the green-sweep. assign owner: @alex for sweep orchestration.
alex: noted. planning 1905 start full green sweep across build matrix. will post progress updates here.
jo: leaving a note — create follow-up ticket to revert timeout post-cut (label: revert-temp-qa). I'll add to release checklist.
maya: thanks all. if anything else pops up, ping here. :sparkles:
